reference_sql:
SELECT p.category_raw, length(p.category_raw) AS n_chars, COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.category_name = p.category_raw
WHERE c.category_id IS NULL
GROUP BY p.category_raw
alternatives:
SELECT p.category_raw, length(p.category_raw) AS n_chars, COUNT(*) AS n_products
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c WHERE c.category_name = p.category_raw)
GROUP BY p.category_raw
SELECT category_raw, length(category_raw) AS n_chars, COUNT(*) AS n_products FROM products WHERE category_raw NOT IN (SELECT category_name FROM categories) GROUP BY category_raw
